title: waitUntil
description: Shared readiness conditions, shaped by the kind of surface a step targets. Browser surfaces wait on page conditions; process surfaces wait on stdio output or a fixed delay; app surfaces wait on an element or a fixed delay. Unlike goTo's navigation readiness, no condition applies by default — a step waits only on the conditions it names.

d1f13a2b41768.description: Wait for network activity to be idle (no new requests) for this duration in milliseconds.

deacb609dfcf7.description: Selector for the element to wait for. On browser surfaces, a CSS selector. On app surfaces, a native selector — an XPath (`//`), or `~` for an accessibility id; CSS is rejected at runtime.

d85ea5a8fe519.description: Text content the element must contain. Supports exact match or regex pattern using /pattern/ syntax.

d51f552441335.description: ID attribute of the element to find. Supports exact match or regex pattern using /pattern/ syntax.

de98afd642d66.description: data-testid attribute of the element to find. Supports exact match or regex pattern using /pattern/ syntax.

d36879a346bf0.description: Class or array of classes that the element must have. Each class supports exact match or regex pattern using /pattern/ syntax. Element must have all specified classes.

df5fb044d9398.description: Object of attribute key-value pairs that the element must have. Values can be strings (supporting /pattern/ regex), numbers, or booleans. Boolean true matches attribute presence, false matches absence.

da993bab30b8c.description: Computed accessible name of the element per ARIA specification. Supports exact match or regex pattern using /pattern/ syntax.

d11e73ac9ef8f.title: Element criteria
d11e73ac9ef8f.description: Wait for a specific element to be present. At least one finding field must be specified.

domIdleTime.description: Wait for DOM mutations to stop for this duration in milliseconds.

stdio.description: Wait until combined stdout+stderr matches. Substring, or /regex/.
